calls.reason: CBRE reports 1.4% vacancy and strong preleasing, but those figures do not settle the eventual fate of the planned AI data centers. The packet lacks evidence of widespread permanent abandonment or nonuse.
Data Center Knowledge describes one bankrupt project subsequently acquired for redevelopment. Neither that report nor American Compute establishes $200 billion of failures with recovery below 25%.

NVIDIA's filing reports $30 billion in cloud commitments, while OpenAI announces $30 billion from NVIDIA alongside infrastructure ties. These support the core financing claim, though IREN's investment is conditional and the six-year endpoint is imprecise.

Sherlund reports an October selloff and TechRadar describes a Chinese crash, but CB Insights reports strong funding through September. This mixed evidence does not establish the broad collapse predicted without a deadline.

CoreWeave and IREN report growing AI revenues alongside losses and continued financing. Those results establish neither inevitable failure nor durable independence from the financing Zitron criticizes.

Zillow reports faster development and maintained quality, but provides no independent outcome measurements. The packet lacks the underlying deck or independent verification of 29,000 additional monthly review hours.
